mode: Read-only source review and disposable offline runtime probes. No repository, Board, trust policy, remote-ref or model-provider writes/calls.
verdict: No confirmed blocking defect found within the reviewed authority/replay and combined integration scope. This is not operational trust-root approval or a claim of comprehensive security.

independent_verification.name: Existing authority and combined integration suite rerun
Independent signed-carrier, retry and cross-component probes
independent_verification.portability: Set ARGO_REVIEW_ROOT to a checkout of the reviewed commit with its locked dependencies installed. Uses native Node24 and real signed ledgers in newly created temporary directories; each test removes its ledger. No process, provider or network mocks are needed. The witness adjudicator is an injected deterministic host callback.
assertions: A legacy-valid, correctly signed configure carrier with an inner system requester using another service principal ID is rejected by character replay with CORRUPT_LEDGER.
A legacy-valid, correctly signed speech carrier whose request hash binds an earlier cursor is rejected by reconstructed-prefix hash verification.
Two concurrently adjudicated same-ID commands with different authenticated principal IDs yield one commit and one CONFLICT, never a second character record.

A pending witness grant cannot append across a profile reconfiguration. After a later successful speech and actor death, an exact committed retry returns the original receipt without append; new speech is refused.

A valid legacy outsider observation falsely naming the traveler is not captured as character speech. Genuine carrier content stays out of traveler/donor/outsider legacy LEXI views. Merely addressing donor does not confer an acquisition in its character view.

A real proxy custody action preserves the donor as action actor and proxy as principal actor, renders literal item/recipient details, omits the private grant ID, replays every committed prefix and returns deeply immutable detached projection DTOs.

source_evidence.conclusion: Configured system identity, direct player/NPC life, active nature, cooldown, grant hash/membership and inner semantics are checked at admission and preceding-prefix replay. Signature verification precedes carrier processing.

Request identity includes principal and exact cursor. Inputs and callback DTOs are detached. Adjudication runs outside the ledger writer lock; a fresh prefix and final ledger CAS guard append. Simultaneous exact retries recover only the committed matching receipt.

Archive text is a deterministic action whitelist and preserves action actor versus authenticated proxy operator. It excludes raw grant/consent bodies and hidden RNG bookkeeping. Capture starts once after first configure.

The host reader owns the projection capability. Public readers bind principal, full scope and current cursor; actor and narrator filters select distinct DTOs. Combined integration uses the actual ledger and these readers.

Existing integration exercises real storage, bridge/authority, opposing private impressions, reader/narrator restrictions, injected prose clients, busy silence and a committed cutoff during generation. It does not make live model calls.

limits_and_declined_to_judge.limit: Host authentication and witness reality are trusted inputs, not established by JSON role labels, a request hash, or a signed carrier. No live identity or physical perception service was tested.

A hostile holder of the configured writer capability can assert a semantically valid but physically false witness grant or requester. The runtime validates binding and eligibility, not independent proof of those host assertions.

The combined view factory and full projection remain privileged capabilities. Review assumes workers receive only scoped DTOs/loaders as documented; no production deployment wiring or process capability sandbox was audited here.

Old v1 source/lifecycle permission gaps remain by explicit compatibility policy. The independent spoof probe verifies separation from the new character archive, not global repair of legacy observations.

No large-history performance or crash-recovery campaign was run. Character projection performs full verified event replay; the frozen profile explicitly retains ledger replay and manual crash-recovery limits. No rollback anchor or independent storage freshness assurance is added.
Source sequence/cursor gaps remain visible; this does not conceal all hidden event existence, timing or count metadata.

No claim of model-level prompt-injection resistance, prose quality, truthfulness or stable voice follows from injected offline client tests. Narration has no writer in the reviewed adapter, and cutoff/context checks are deterministic.
Protected application-policy adoption and supervisor approval are separate from this review. No board state or trust policy was promoted.
